name: Milk and milk products
notes: Includes lactose. Ghee, paneer, curd, butter and cream are milk products.

name: Wheat / cereals containing gluten
notes: FDA lists wheat; FSSAI lists cereals containing gluten (wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt).

name: Sesame
notes: Major allergen in the US since 1 Jan 2023 (FASTER Act). Not on the FSSAI mandatory list, but a common allergen.
